items.title: Lionel Messi wins award days after controversial FIFA World Cup Final - Yahoo Sports
items.summary: # Lionel Messi wins award days after controversial FIFA World Cup Final. Lionel Messi has secured an honor just days after Argentina fell short in the FIFA World Cup Final against Spain. The final was tarnished, however, by Argentina's attempts to disrupt proceedings throughout, with Lionel Scaloni's team trying to undermine Spain's dominance through deliberate fouls at every turn. Spain's World Cup triumph also resulted in its captain, Rodri, claiming the FIFA World Cup Golden Ball, an accolade presented to the competition's standout performer, and one Messi collected four years earlier after guiding Argentina to victory in Qatar. "The International Federation of Football History and Statistics is proud to announce that Lionel Messi of Argentina has been named the IFFHS Best Player, the highest individual honor bestowed by our federation upon the outstanding performer of the tournament," the organization said in a statement.

items.summary: # Lionel Messi & Kylian Mbappe beaten to World Cup Goal of the Tournament award as iconic strike vs Argentina takes the prize. Sidny Lopes Cabral has officially secured the 2026 World Cup Goal of the Tournament award following his spectacular effort against Argentina. The Cabo Verde star produced a moment of magic that saw off stiff competition from some of the biggest names in world football. FIFA has confirmed that Cabral's stunning strike against Argentina in the round of 32 has been voted the Hyundai Goal of the Tournament for the 2026 World Cup. The 23-year-old Rotterdam-born defender produced a moment of individual brilliance that resonated with fans globally, ultimately seeing him top a shortlist that included Messi, Mbappe, and Julian Alvarez. Lopes Cabral revealed that Marcelo, one of his career idols, sent him a congratulatory message confirming that he had voted for the Cabo Verdean's effort.
